# Singapore Property & Finance - Daily Brief (property + finance)
_Auto-generated 21 Jul 2026 (SGT). Source-linked. General information only; exact figures and eligibility are confirmed case by case._

## New Launch Update: Lentor Gardens Residences

- **Lentor Gardens Residences sells 270 units at S$2,350 psf average on launch day** - Kingsford Group's 499-unit development achieved a 54% take-up rate on its 18 July 2026 launch, with 270 units sold at an average price of about S$2,350 psf. [Source](https://www.99.co/singapore/insider/lentor-gardens-residences-sells-270-units-at-an-average-of-s2350-psf/)
- **Three-bedroom compact units fully sold; no new Lentor Hills launch expected until 2027** - Among the layouts, three-bedroom compact units were the first to sell out entirely at launch, and no further new project launches in the Lentor Hills area are anticipated before 2027. [Source](https://stackedhomes.com/lentor-gardens-residences-sold-54-at-launch/)
- **Developers' new home sales hit a two-year low in June before expected July rebound** - Only 156 private homes (excluding ECs) were sold by developers in June 2026, with the mid-year school holidays compounding a typical seasonal slowdown. [Source](https://www.99.co/singapore/insider/developers-new-home-sales-fall-to-a-2-year-low-in-june-rebound-expected-in-july/)

## HDB Resale Records & Senior Housing Policy

- **Queenstown 2-room flat sets national resale record at S$696,000** - A high-floor 2-room unit at SkyParc @ Dawson changed hands on 15 July 2026 for S$696,000, the highest price ever recorded nationally for a 2-room HDB resale flat. [Source](https://www.99.co/singapore/insider/2-room-national-record-broken-as-queenstown-unit-sells-for-s696000/)
- **Geylang 4-room flat sells for $1.1 million, setting a new district record** - A 4-room flat at 82B Circuit Road (MacPherson Spring) sold for $1.1 million in July 2026, surpassing the previous Geylang record by $12,000 despite being on a lower floor. [Source](https://stackedhomes.com/4-room-hdb-flat-set-a-new-geylang-price-record-at-1-1m/)
- **Community Care Apartments eligibility age lowered to 55; monthly fees cut by up to 75%** - MOH, MND and HDB announced the minimum qualifying age for Community Care Apartments drops from 65 to 55, and mandatory monthly service fees are being reduced by between 18% and 75%. [Source](https://www.99.co/singapore/insider/community-care-apartments-seniors-from-age-55-fees-reduced-by-up-to-75/)

## Rental Market

- **Condo and HDB rents edge higher in June after a quieter May** - The 99-SRX Rental Flash Report recorded a broad-based recovery in both transaction volumes and rent levels across condo and HDB segments in June 2026. [Source](https://www.99.co/singapore/insider/condo-hdb-rental-market-rebound-june-2026/)
